offence_note: Manslaughter by fatal push in altercation
sentence_quote: I would grant leave to appeal the sentence, but would dismiss the appeal on its merits.
note: Three-year sentence for manslaughter affirmed; appeal court said it was lenient.

offence_note: Break and enter of service station; obstructing police
sentence_quote: I am not able to say that the sentence imposed of 18 months custody, less time served, was unfit.
note: 30 days concurrent for obstruction; co-accused sentenced separately.

offence_note: Assault causing bodily harm on spouse; mischief; breach of recognizance
sentence_quote: the sentence she imposed of 12 months’ incarceration, followed by two years’ probation, can only be described as clearly fit and reasonable.
note: Concurrent 3 months on mischief and breach counts; bail conditions argument rejected.

sentence_quote: a fit and proper sentence is 10 years imprisonment. I have also concluded that there will be a credit for time served on remand of 30 months leaving the sentence remaining to be served at 7 years and 6 months.
note: Victim surcharge waived; co-conspirator got 16 years separately.

offence_note: Vehicle thefts, robbery, identity theft, credit card fraud, obstruction

note: 12 months consecutive to 15 months less credit; total and credit inferred.

offence_note: Tractor trailer thefts, robberies, kidnapping, imitation firearm
sentence_quote: I would reduce Mr. Baskaran’s sentence to nine years (before credit for pre-sentence custody).
note: Kanthasamy did not appeal sentence (8.5 years); conviction appeals dismissed.

offence_note: Manslaughter by dragging gas station attendant under stolen car
sentence_quote: I would credit him at a ratio of one to one, grant leave to appeal and allow the appeal by reducing Mr. Pratt's sentence to five years, ten months' incarceration, for an effective sentence of seven years.
systemic_quote: the Act requires greater attention to this circumstance than was accorded by the sentencing judge
note: Adult sentence for 16-year-old, considered under youth justice principles; reduced from 7y3m.
